title: Cauliflower Rice and Beans Fajita Bowls
description: This cauliflower rice fajita bowl features roasted, seasoned bell pepper and onion topped with pinto beans and cilantro for a superb vegetarian dish.
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, sliced, or more to taste
1 small red onion, halved and sliced
1 (15.5 ounce) can pinto beans, rinsed and drained

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Cover a baking sheet with aluminum foil, ensuring the foil goes up the sides of the sheet to catch all the juices.

Combine cauliflower, red bell pepper, red onion, olive oil, garlic, fajita seasoning, cumin, and salt in a large bowl; stir until evenly coated. Spread vegetable mixture onto the prepared baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 15 minutes; stir and continue roasting until tender and lightly browned, about 15 minutes more.
Top with pinto beans, cotija cheese, cilantro, pepitas, green onions, and lime juice. Spoon into 4 serving bowls.

video.description: Make dinner in a sheet pan, then serve it around in bowls! Plus, gain all the nutrition and lose none of the flavor when you sub cauliflower in for rice! Combine riced cauliflower with red bell pepper and red onion, then toss with olive oil, garlic, fajita seasoning, cumin and salt and roast for a half an hour. Serve in bowls topped with pinto beans, cotija cheese, cilantro, pepitas, green onion, and a spritz of lime juice. Every spoonful is delish!
